project_title: House Of The Knight - Haute Parfumerie
archetype: LUXURY & SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST (Multi-Million Dollar Royal Perfume House)

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-normal tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight
hierarchy.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg text-muted-foreground font-sans tracking-wide font-light
hierarchy.overline: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-[#C5A059] font-sans font-semibold

perfumes_catalog.name: Blonde Amber
perfumes_catalog.subtitle: An elixir of liquid gold, rare ambergris & smoky dried fruits
perfumes_catalog.story: Created for royal galas in Mayfair. Blonde Amber encapsulates the warmth of amber light reflecting off crystal chandeliers.

perfumes_catalog.name: Layton
perfumes_catalog.subtitle: Distinguished nobility with noble bergamot, lavender & warm vanilla
perfumes_catalog.story: A fragrance that captivates through its elegance and intensity. Inspired by the royal courtyards of Versailles.

perfumes_catalog.name: Angels' Share On The Rocks
perfumes_catalog.subtitle: Oak cognac barrels, crystallised cinnamon & icy praline twist
perfumes_catalog.story: Derived from the liquor evaporated during cognac aging in oak barrels, chilled over handcrafted crystal ice.

perfumes_catalog.name: Side Effect
perfumes_catalog.subtitle: Hypnotic blend of tobacco, rum, cinnamon bark & dark leather
perfumes_catalog.story: An enigmatic spell that awakens the senses with unabashed passion and mysterious dark accords.

header_nav.style: Glassmorphism header with 1px gold/subtle border, blur backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-black/80 z-50 fixed top-0 left-0 right-0
elements: Brand Crest & Typography ('HOUSE OF THE KNIGHT')
Nav Links: Collection, Our Heritage, Scent Notes, Custom Engraving
Action Buttons: Search, Currency Switcher (₹ INR), Wishlist, Cart Drawer Trigger (with counter badge), Account Modal, Admin Access

hero_3d_section.concept: 3D Canvas rendered with React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber & @react-three/drei). Procedural crystal glass perfume bottle with rotating metallic knight crest tag, reflective cap, liquid refractivity, lighting rig, and interactive camera drag/orbit.
hero_3d_section.fallback: High resolution webgl canvas / procedural fallback if R3F context drops
hero_3d_section.reveal_effect: Framer Motion line-by-line masked reveal animation for headlines and CTA

editorial_marquee.style: Low-contrast luxury ribbon with slow kinetic drift. Text: 'HAUTE PARFUMERIE • LONDON & PARIS • CRAFTED FOR ROYALTY • EXTRACTED FROM NATURE'S RAREST BOTANICALS • HOUSE OF THE KNIGHT'

product_grid.style: Asymmetric Bento Grid (MODE A Tetris Layout) with high-density card detailing, gold hover border glow, note badges, and Quick Add / Explore Fragrance actions

notes_pyramid_component.style: Interactive 3-tier pyramid component (Top Notes, Heart Notes, Base Notes) with visual ingredients pill badges and olfactory radar

cart_drawer.style: Slide-over drawer from right with order summary, complimentary royal sample selector, progress to free shipping tier, and instant checkout button (deferred payment gateway flow)

admin_panel.style: High-density dashboard with inventory manager, price modifier, order status updater (Pending, Processing, Dispatched, Delivered), low-stock warning thresholds, total revenue stats in INR (₹), and authentication tab (Email/Password & Simulated Google Sign-In)

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling library enabled for fluid luxury momentum

framer_motion_presets.fade_up: { initial: { opacity: 0, y: 30 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, transition: { duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] } }
framer_motion_presets.mask_reveal: { initial: { y: '100%' }, animate: { y: '0%' }, transition: { duration: 1, ease: [0.25, 1, 0.5, 1] } }

general_ui_ux_guidelines.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive buttons, links, form inputs, dialog triggers, tabs, table rows, and key text metrics MUST include a unique kebab-case data-testid attribute.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.hover_state_rule: Every button or clickable element must explicitly define hover text and background color (e.g. hover:bg-neutral-900 hover:text-white dark:hover:bg-neutral-100 dark:hover:text-black transition-colors duration-300).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.accessibility: Contrast ratio minimum 4.5:1 for standard text, 3:1 for large display text. Clear focus outlines for keyboard navigation.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.code_format: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components. Do NOT use TypeScript interfaces or .tsx files.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Ensure all 4 perfumes (Blonde Amber, Layton, Angels Share On The Rocks, Side Effect) are accurately rendered with full details and ₹ INR pricing.
3. Build the 3D interactive bottle hero section in JS with R3F or Three.js fallback canvas.
4. Build full functionality: Cart drawer, product detail modal/view, customer account portal with order history, and full-fledged Admin Panel for inventory and order management.
5. Ensure data-testid attributes are added to all interactive elements.
